mapper.sql: SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.training_name AS trainingName, t.trainer_id AS trainerId, t.approval_status AS approvalStatus, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trainee_enrollment te WHERE te.training_id = t.training_id) AS totalStudents FROM training t
mapper.select: WHERE t.approval_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
WHERE t.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
